records.rationale: The migration code at lines 9-15 uses `execute(...)[0]['id'].to_i` to get the category_id. If the SQL query returns no rows (when embed_category setting doesn't match any category name), accessing `[0]` on an empty result will return nil, and then calling `['id']` on nil will raise a NoMethodError. The code does handle category_id == 0 case on line 17, but it will crash before reaching that check

The migration deletes the 'embeddable_hosts' and 'embed_category' site settings at the end, but if the migration fails partway through (e.g., during the INSERT loop), the data could be in an inconsistent state. More critically, the migration doesn't handle the case where the PostgreSQL result might return nil or have different structure - the code accesses [0]['id'] and [0]['value'] without nil ch
